headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, and major claims. Use italic variants for emphasis.

primary.description: Vedic Gold - Use for primary CTAs and key highlights

secondary.description: Cosmic Indigo - Use for secondary buttons and deep contrast areas

text.description: Deep Indigo instead of Black for softer, premium contrast

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all shadow-glow hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-secondary border border-secondary/20 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-secondary/5 transition-all

cards.pricing: relative overflow-hidden bg-white border border-gold/20 rounded-3xl p-10 shadow-card hover:shadow-xl transition-all

inputs.default: bg-white/50 border-secondary/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 transition-all

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px, Gold or Indigo color

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME ENFORCEMENT: Strictly adhere to the Light/Gold/Indigo palette. Do NOT use dark mode by default.
2. TYPOGRAPHY: Use Playfair Display for ALL headings. Import it from Google Fonts immediately.
3. GLASSMORPHISM: Use the defined glassmorphism classes for the header and floating elements.
4. SHADCN CUSTOMIZATION: Override default Shadcn radius to '0.75rem' and use the custom colors defined above.
5. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
6. FORMS: The Birth Details form is the core conversion point. Make it beautiful, multi-step, and reassuring.
7. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. No centered text blocks without purpose.
Use 2-3x more padding than usual. White space is luxury.
Micro-interactions are mandatory for every click and hover.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use the defined Cosmic Indigo or Dark Grey.
Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards against the light background.
